reasons.text: Duplicate check found another claim (08f1dbd6-dd98-5df3-bbbf-18468e91a10a) sharing the same payout destination as this claim. Under the policy, a shared payout account requires a flag.
The label photo is legible and shows model P1413-P, which is not one of the recalled models (P1410, P1410-P, P1411, P1411-P). On the model rule alone this would be a denial.
The claimed purchase date of 2006-01-05 is before the sale window opens on 2006-10-01, so the purchase falls outside the eligible period. This would also be a denial on its own.
The retailer (www.amazon.com) is on the sold-at list, so retailer eligibility is not the issue. The serial check was skipped because the program has no serial rule for this recall.
